newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Flour seeks 16,900 tonnes of U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Korea Flour seeks 16,900 tonnes of U.S. wheat.

text.p: South Korea's Korea Flour Milling Corp invited tenders to buy 16,900 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat by 2:00 p.m. (0500 GMT) on Wednesday, traders said.
Shipment was slated for June 1-30 from the Pacific Northwest to the western port city of Mokpo, traders said.

They said the company was seeking 6,000 tonnes of soft white wheat (minimum protein 10.0 percent), 2,500 tonnes of soft white (maximum protein 9.5 percent), 4,400 tonnes of hard red winter (HRW), and 4,000 tonnes of dark northern spring (DNS).
